name: Leon Vitry
source:
The main hero of this story.
The young president of a famous, world-leading company.

Leon is generally a gentle and pleasant young man to many he interacts with.
He rebuilt the Vitry family, which was on the verge of bankruptcy, by engaging in arms trading during the war. Due to this he is sometimes referred to as the merchant of death.
